title: Organization management requires real IO and browser verification
summary: Expose configurable Dot admission and organization people operations through the same governed CLI and UI facades.
reusable_steps: Expose configurable Dot admission and organization people operations through the same governed CLI and UI facades
expected_outcome: Keep Dot admission capacity distinct from execution concurrency; default bundled charters to 100 while preserving explicit custom limits. Apply live changes through pause, preview, apply and activate, retaining unrelated charter fields. Expose humans, plural roles, the current operator, agent lifecycle and accountable humans. Mocked facade tests can miss journal lease grants: validate real secure IO, authority, leases and projections in a product-policy-only synthetic fixture. Also verify an authenticated browser save and tenant denial. Preserve the native Request origin for Next mutation guards; never compensate for host normalization by trusting aliases or forwarded headers. Keep owner/context/version checks and ambiguous-write recovery in the UI.
